svg.title: Inside the engine
svg.text: Seven stages, each with one owner. Names are real modules and functions; thresholds and weights stay private.
What is true today, against this person's own baseline
weights shift on a drug day
How many sets each muscle earns this week
MEV, MAV, MRV from own data
a gap is re-entry, not week N
What kind of day this is
what the log says he does
effort band by week of block
one lift, two apps, one key
How heavy, and how many reps
the gym's real steps, from the log
today's effort cap, as a load
asks for a stale e1RM refresh
Everything above, handed to a model
notes pulled when data is thin
Claude in chat, no key here
Nothing is stored unless it passes
stored, pushed to Hevy, executed, logged
The engine re-fits itself from what actually happened, and each loop feeds named stages above.
Every lift re-scored from closed weeks.
Last week's add, hold or cut graded.
Personal bands, same window as the gate.
Flags when the engine itself degrades.
